result.summary: The page is generally polished, but one header control appears to be missing its icon/content, and horizontally scrollable content is clipped somewhat awkwardly at the right edge.

issues.description: The circular control in the upper-right is mostly blank, showing only a tiny red dot. It looks like an avatar, map, or notification icon failed to render.
issues.suggestion: Restore the intended icon or image and ensure a fallback graphic is displayed if the asset cannot load.

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” carousel end with partially visible items at the right edge, including clipped restaurant text. Although this may indicate horizontal scrolling, the cutoff looks abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent trailing padding and tune item widths or scroll snapping so the next item is exposed intentionally without clipping its text awkwardly.
